title: A prison cell is 128 by 176, in rows of five, two or three tiers high
rule: Build a cell as Nova Prospekt does: 128 wide and 176 deep inside, 120 clear under an 8 slab (a storey of 128), partitions 16 thick at a pitch of 144, a front wall 16 thick with the opening 52 to 56 wide and 108 high in its middle (38 from each partition, a 20 lintel over it) and the door (prison_celldoor001a barred or prison_heavydoor001a solid) sliding along the outside face under prison_doortrack001a. Cells go in rows of five, two or three tiers high at 128. Furnish only the cells people go into; leave the rest bare. Our cells module is 128 by 160 by 128: ask the owner first before changing it.
why: 71 cells in 16 rows in d2_prison_02, 03, 04 and 07 (21 November): every one 128 by 176 inside at a pitch of 144 (d2_prison_02 -1040..-864 from y 2608; d2_prison_03 3968..4144 from x -4048; d2_prison_04 -624..-448 from y 1792, three tiers with cell floors at 128, 256 and 384). Openings 52 to 56 by 108 (46 lintels 16 by 52 to 56 by 20; slab 16 and 112 clear in d2_prison_04). 36 of the 71 are empty, 13 have a bed, only 3 the full kit (bed, toilet, sink, heater).
how: A cell row helper for a Combine prison piece: n cells at 144, the opening centred, a sliding door model on a func_door riding the outside face, the track 53 over the door's middle; the full kit (d2_prison_03 -3628 3997 0): toilet on the back wall's middle 25 off it, sink on a side wall 45 from the back and 16 off, prison_heater002a on the same side nearer the door, prison_metalbed001a along the other side, prison_flourescentlight002b (skin 1) on the ceiling's middle, a cage lamp outside beside the door at 86. Empty cells keep their door and their dark.

rule: The walk along an upper tier is the cell storey's own slab carried out 56 to 80 past the cell fronts, 8 thick, with handrail04_long props end to end along its edge (128 long, the model's origin 20 over the walk) and an unseen clip 40 high behind them; interior_fence002c panels close a walk's end. Two rows facing each other stand 224 apart with a well 64 wide between their walks and an open stair in the well (60 wide, treads 2 thick, 8 by 12). A tall block puts three tiers on one side of a hall 448 wide and about 512 high. A prison_cagedlight001a on each cell front beside the door, 86 up, 128 to 144 apart, only one in five to ten lit. Keep the owner's stairs (16 by 24) where a stair is ours: ask the owner first before using Valve's.

Guard office: controlroom_desk001b 24 to 58 off a wall, controlroom_chair001a 44 from it, file cabinets 73 to 131 away on the walls, a monitor on the desk, a switch box by the door, a ceiling panel; a guard room over a cellblock gets a corner cut at 45 with a band of glass and the desk turned to it. Laundry: dryers in twos and threes 76 to 92 apart, a few degrees off square; washers on the walls; carts loose. Kitchen: counters in a line, stoves on the wall 217 apart. title: The Combine's walls stand square in plan but lean, and its sections are lop-sided lozenges
rule: Where the Combine builds its own place, its walls run on the axes in plan but lean 14 to 23 degrees off upright: panels 128 high set back 32 (1 in 4) or 40 (5 in 16), or 104 high set back 44. The foot leans back and the head leans over, so a hall or shaft opens out low and closes in high, in steps that differ from one side to the other. A train runs in a trench of the metal 336 wide at the foot that steps out 32 a side every 112 to 128. The metal is metalwall077a at texture scale 0.5. New Combine pieces can be built so; ask the owner first before changing the checkpoint, depot or armoury, which stand upright.
why: d2_prison_06 and 08 (21 November): wall area of the Combine's metal is 99% on the axes in plan, but 14% (06) and 7% (08) of it slopes: 137 leaning faces, 128 high set back 32 (41) or 40 (34), 104 high set back 44 (23); faces leaning back 14 degrees and leaning over 17 and 23. The pod shafts of d2_prison_08 (1680..2032 by 2816..4096, -960 to 192): 256 wide at the foot, out to about 400, straight for 600, in to 224 at the head, the two sides stepping at different heights. The train trench of d2_prison_06 at x 3000: 336, 400, 464 wide at -576, -448, -320. metalwall077a at 0.5 on 89% of its area in 08 and 60% in 06 (the old prison 0.25 on 94%).
how: A Combine wall helper that stacks 128 courses each set in or out 32 or 40 (a lean of 1 in 4 or 5 in 16) with the faces cut as planes, not stepped boxes; one side of a hall stepping at 128 and the other at 104 or 112. Studied further later (the owner wants the Combine's own architecture).

title: The Combine's lights and consoles are turned to aim; its racks, fences and locks stay square
rule: Inside the old prison its own fixtures sit square (97% on exact 90s). The Combine's things are square on about three quarters: its wall lights are turned to aim at what they light (yaw by 15 or 45, a few pitched down 18), its consoles and small monitors set at free angles to the room; but pod racks, fences, locks, doors and generators stand square to the walls. Turn a Combine light or console off the grid on purpose; never a rack or a fence.
why: d2_prison_01 to 08 (21 November): of 390 unparented Combine props, 284 on exact 90s, 46 on 15s, 21 on 45s, 39 free; combine_light002a 58 of 66 off the grid (37 on 15s, 16 on 45s; d2_prison_07 yaw 300 pitch -18 in a row of four); combine_interface003 yaw 24, 69, 204, 294, 356 (d2_prison_07 -1358 -1904); combine_smallmonitor001 5 of 5 free; combine_fence01a/b 40 of 40, cell_01_pod 20 of 20, combine_lock01 9 of 9 square. prison_ models 880 of 903 square.
how: Combine dressing in our pieces: the light helper aims each combine_light002a at its target and rounds the yaw to 15; consoles get a free yaw within 30 of facing the room; racks, fences and locks stay square (valve-turn-the-loose for loose things).

title: The Combine keeps prisoners in pods: racks two high, trains of pods, arrays in shafts
rule: The Combine's own prison is pods, not cells. Racks: cell_01_pod with cell_01_rigging on cell_01_supportsb, two high 193 apart, 185 to 203 apart along a row, square to the wall. On a train: pods on both sides of each car 64 apart, one side 32 lower than the other, about one slot in six left empty. In a shaft: cell_array_01 at the foot, pairs facing. For a Combine prison or the Nexus, a pod rack is the Combine's look; the old cells are the people's prison it took over.

extra.how: Nova Prospekt's interiors (d2_prison_01 to 08, 21 November) are two-toned at 128: where two wall faces stack the material changes on 4506 and stays on 3248, and 2721 of the changes are 128 over the floor, the lower band the same plaster's darker partner (plasterwall034c under 034a or 034b 393, 018c/e under 018a/b 225, 035c/d under 035a/b 184, 032c under 032b 159, tilewall009b under plasterwall026a 300, concretewall022a under 004c 116), no rail between. Our rooms keep the owner's dado at 56: ask the owner first before a prison piece uses 128.

Nova Prospekt (21 November): prison_flourescentlight002b, the flat ceiling panel (96, skin 1 on 94), is lit every time: light_spot 159 237 215 600 (or 255 245 145 400 to 600), cone 70, inner 20 to 30, pitch -74, constant attenuation 500000, at the model; the hanging tubes are dressing (prison_flourescentlight001b lit 0 of 130, 001a 14 of 110); prison_cagedlight001a lit 61 of 154, with light_glow03 at scale 0.75, and in the cellblocks only one in five to ten.

Nova Prospekt's corridors are wider and taller than the city's (d2_prison_01 to 08, 21 November): 245 of 535 corridor nodes are 192 wide (under 120 to 128 mostly), 75 are 128 wide (under 192); halls 256 by 128 to 192 (256 nodes) and 384 by 128 to 256 (182).

Nova Prospekt (21 November): the Combine's metal is 0 to 1% of brush area in the old prison (d2_prison_01 to 05, 07), 20% in its depot and train yard (06) and 81% in its teleport works (08). In the old buildings it comes as props (pods, consoles, lights, fences, turrets), field walls (comshieldwall3 func_brush 2 thick, 126 high), consoles built of 25 to 30 small metalcombine001 brushes with doorbutton002a buttons (d2_prison_07 -632 -3390 -168), and thin metalcombine001 panels 2 to 10 thick bolted on at angles (87% angled). Where a plate is laid on an old wall it touches it (gap 0 on 34 of 38 in d2_prison_06 and 08); most of the Combine's slabs stand free as its own walls (115 of 153).
The Combine's metalwall077a is laid at 0.5 (89% of its area in d2_prison_08, 60% in 06) while the old prison round it stays at 0.25 (94%).

Nova Prospekt sets whole rooms to 8 (10 to 25% of faces in d2_prison_02 to 08 against 3 to 4% in the city), walls and floors alike and not only near lamps (33% of faces at 8 within 192 of a light, 39% at 16).

Nova Prospekt cuts its corners smaller than the city: chamfers 4 off (5.7 wide) and 3 off (4.2) are the commonest in d2_prison_02 to 07 (d2_prison_05: 108 and 53; d2_prison_03: 97 at 3 off), 2 off next.
